findings.title: Local filesystem oracle boundary omits retained source copies and external results
findings.observed: Real sandbox-exec plus real native FileOps read the retained corrected source IR tasks.textproto and an external raw-private sentinel. The denied evaluator-site copy failed to read. Only content digests were recorded.
requiredClosure: Deny canonical paths for every retained evaluator/oracle source/data copy and actual episode/stage/private results roots; reject overlap with worker staging.
Prove real sandbox plus native FileOps denies both previously readable targets while worker-owned files remain usable. Do not rely on native relative-path confinement or a network/u2 exclusion.

findings.title: Forced-worker evidence disappears on result parse or archival errors and scheduling can continue
findings.observed: A controlled forced receipt plus truncated JSON raised JSONDecodeError without returning the receipt. An archival failure after an attempted forced worker produced fsq=null, cleanupFailure=false, invalid_agent, and halt_reason=None.
requiredClosure: Preserve process/ownership/termination evidence before parsing or archival, independently of native result validity.
Keep post-spawn missing process/cleanup evidence explicitly unknown; halt scheduling on forced or unproven worker cleanup even when official task/environment cleanup succeeds.
Cover truncated result and archival-error transitions; prove no next task is scheduled.

findings.title: Official scoring and ordering claim do not require observed successful native kill
findings.observed: The actual runner accepted a controlled completed full-native envelope with zero write events and no kill, called the official evaluator once, and claimed after_complete_native_FSQ_and_kill_and_internal_verification. Real native code statically enforces schema-valid final output, not kill occurrence; Harness close is not app_stop.
requiredClosure: Prove successful model-issued native kill and its required ordering before main final/full-return/official scoring; omitted, failed, or budget-denied kill must not satisfy this ordering gate.
Do not synthesize a replacement kill, suppress original kill, rewrite native Skills, or claim kill from close()/literal test events.

Record evidence-backed ordering and cover missing/failed/denied kill plus a valid native sequence. Preserve full FSQ internal verification and exactly one terminal official evaluation after the admitted full return.

findings.title: Worker SIGTERM escalation observes only the leader, leaving owned same-group children alive
findings.observed: Actual _supervise returned after leader SIGTERM with terminated=true/killed=false while its same-group SIGTERM-ignoring child remained in S state. Probe-owned group was then SIGKILLed and child disappearance observed.
requiredClosure: Observe and settle remaining owned group members through the grace window even if the leader exits; escalate remaining owned members without killing shared services or process-name matches.
Report group cleanup separately from leader exit and halt on unproven cleanup.
Prove the same-group SIGTERM-ignoring child is gone before supervisor completion; clean all probe descendants.

findings.title: Public standalone episode bypasses the outer episode watchdog
findings.observed: Actual public main(argv) with controlled offline admission/environment entered blocked initialization. A 0.2-second injected episode bound did not stop it; external termination was required at 4 seconds. No model or device was invoked.
requiredClosure: Route the public standalone entry through the bounded outer supervisor; keep direct run_episode only as its supervised internal operation.
Exercise blocked initialization and/or terminal evaluation through the public entry under a shortened envelope; prove bounded owned-process termination and explicit unknown/forced cleanup.
Preserve exact original documented allocator/envelope and exclusive resource checks; do not replace them with a receipt-age TTL.

findings.title: Report consumer accepts an answer different from the referenced native runner summary
findings.observed: Changing only mainAnswer.summary to a different string and updating its outcome hash still returned operational_errors=[]. The referenced runner retained exact parsed summary.
requiredClosure: Require exact selected-summary equality with the unique successful referenced agent_runtime.runner task_run_v1 output and preserve empty/whitespace/Unicode and business status.
Reject mismatched summaries through report consumption; do not accept top-level/pre-plan/verifier substitutes or compare normalized strings.

findings.title: Report consumer does not reconcile counted dispatch audit with budget counters
findings.observed: Actual NativeDispatchBudget generated 11 counted successful write admissions. An outcome declaring maximum=10 and admitted/succeeded/failed/inFlight=0 retained those identical embedded/journal events and still returned operational_errors=[]. No device action was executed.
requiredClosure: Replay counted-write attempted/completion/denial transitions by ticket and compare totals, outstanding tickets, and maximum with the snapshot; reject duplicates/unmatched events and contradictory counters.
Preserve valid zero-write runs, failed admissions without refund, and denied writes without admission; cover the demonstrated 11-versus-10 contradiction.

findings.title: Stage admission does not bind episode stage, native task identity, or serial
findings.observed: A fully rehashed 12-attempt calibration report containing a smoke-stage episode was qualified. A native outcome and TaskResult with another campaign/task ID and serial emulator-9998 instead of emulator-5560 also returned operational_errors=[].
requiredClosure: Bind every episode to the expected stage, campaign, manifest, readiness and authorization; bind native outcome.taskId and native TaskResult.task_id to the producer episode ID and exact manifest serial.
Reject smoke/calibration reuse as a formal-stage attempt and wrong native task/serial artifacts even when all hashes are internally correct.
Use complete producer-shaped positive fixtures instead of accepting absent stage/native identity fields.
